findings.claim: The analysis does not evaluate any candidate or in-repo substrate for the required `cross_model_check: verified-distinct` decision artifact machinery.
findings.evidence: Goal: "Make every decision artifact carry `cross_model_check: verified-distinct`, reusing the creation-review packet machinery from `adversarial-review-for-creation`." But `gaps_addressed` lists only transport/WASM/WIT/mobile/CRDT/fabric/ideation methodology items and omits cross-model decision artifact metadata; no candidate mentions `cross_model_check`, `verified-distinct`, or `adversarial-review-for-creation`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a gap and candidate evaluation for reusing the creation-review packet machinery, including what existing packet fields can be adopted, what schema changes are needed, and how distinct producer/judge models are verified.

findings.claim: The analysis does not evaluate how to deliver the ideation skill on Claude Code plus a non-Claude harness through `ui-surface` tier detection.
findings.evidence: Goal: "Deliver on at least Claude Code plus one non-Claude harness (Codex or Kimi), through `ui-surface` tier detection rather than harness-specific rendering." The candidate list contains no Codex, Kimi, Claude Code, harness adapter, or `ui-surface` candidate, and `gaps_addressed` contains no harness-delivery or UI-surface gap.
findings.suggested_fix: Add analysis of the existing harness surfaces/adapters and a build-vs-adopt decision for `ui-surface` tier detection, including which non-Claude harness is targeted.

findings.claim: The recommendation orders WIT/mobile fabric work ahead of the actual ideation-skill goals, contradicting the goal set and risking a plan centered on unrelated cross-repo architecture.
findings.evidence: Goals require shipping an ideation skill, cross-model artifacts, automation-bias countermeasures, Karpathy outcome persistence, role separation, harness delivery, and fixtures. Analysis recommendation says: "Resolve the WIT worlds first (OQ-1). Nothing else is worth building twice," followed by "Feature-gate `iroh-docs`" and "Add `frf-transport-iroh`"; these are not required by the listed goals.
findings.suggested_fix: Separate the cross-repo iroh/WIT/mobile findings into a later phase or explicitly mark them non-blocking for the ideation-and-decision-tools deliverables; prioritize the decision-skill substrate first.

findings.claim: The analysis labels the outcome-tracking loop as build-required without evaluating the existing Karpathy wiki or repo storage surfaces it must persist into.
findings.evidence: Goal: "Persist decisions and their outcomes into the Karpathy wiki so a later decision can be checked against what actually happened." `build_required` says "Outcome-tracking loop for decisions" but only justifies it with competitor absence: "No surveyed tool revisits a scored idea against what actually happened"; no candidate evaluates `.prometheus/wiki`, `memory/`, `data/memory.db`, or any Karpathy wiki API/path despite those surfaces appearing in the file tree.
findings.suggested_fix: Add candidates for the in-repo persistence targets and decide whether to adopt an existing wiki/memory mechanism or build a new decision-outcome store.

findings.claim: The analysis omits the coach/reflector producer-not-judge role separation goal from both candidate evaluation and build-required work.
findings.evidence: Goal: "Wire coach and reflector personas as separate roles that cannot grade their own output, following the producer≠judge rule this pack already enforces." `gaps_addressed` has no role-separation or producer≠judge gap, and `build_required` has no coach/reflector item.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a gap for coach/reflector role wiring and evaluate whether the existing producer≠judge machinery can be adopted or must be extended.

findings.claim: The landscape claim that no ideation tools cover the differentiators is not auditable from the candidate list.
findings.evidence: `build_required` claims: "Zero of 21 surveyed commercial tools persist state, track outcomes, do cross-model judging, or implement over-reliance countermeasures." The candidates include only one ideation prior-art entry, `obra/superpowers brainstorming skill`; the packet does not list the 21 tools, criteria, or per-tool verdicts.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the surveyed tools as reference/reject candidates or add an appendix/table with names, criteria, and verdicts so the build-required conclusion is reviewable.
